# Pharnos

> Pharnos is the pharmaceutical regulatory affairs platform for Africa — WAEMU (UEMOA) and ECOWAS (CEDEAO) zones. It combines a RIM catalogue, a CTD Builder aligned with the WAEMU Module 1 framework, dossier lifecycle and correspondence tracking, and Regafy AI assistance. Published by AASK SARL.

The site is bilingual. French is the default (https://pharnos.com/) and every public
page has a pre-rendered English mirror under https://pharnos.com/en/ — both versions
declare hreflang alternates. The application itself lives at https://app.pharnos.com
and the CTD Builder application at https://builder.pharnos.com.

## Platform

- [Home (EN)](https://pharnos.com/en/): what Pharnos does — RIM catalogue, CTD Builder, submission and lifecycle tracking, collaboration between manufacturer and local representative, pricing (free Pilot plan, paid plans from €149/month). French: https://pharnos.com/
- [CTD Builder (EN)](https://pharnos.com/en/ctdbuilder): assembles CTD marketing-authorisation dossiers on your own machine — country-specific Module 1 tree, document filing, structure checks, package compilation. Documents never pass through Pharnos servers. From €49 per compiled dossier. French: https://pharnos.com/ctdbuilder

## Free tools

- [Checking Standard (EN)](https://pharnos.com/en/checking-standard): free completeness diagnostic of a marketing-authorisation dossier against the WAEMU reception standard (Regulation 04/2020/CM/UEMOA), in the browser, no sign-up and no document upload — score, preparation plan, official templates. French: https://pharnos.com/checking-standard
- [Regulatory library (EN)](https://pharnos.com/en/regulatory-library): the official SmPC, package leaflet and labelling templates expected in each of the eight WAEMU countries, free to download, with the country's pharmacovigilance statement already in section 4.8. French: https://pharnos.com/bibliotheque-reglementaire
